name: awesome-symbolic-execution
desc: A curated list of awesome symbolic execution resources including essential research papers, lectures, videos, and tools.

resources.name: Owi
resources.desc: Parallel (dynamic) symbolic execution engine built on WebAssembly (Wasm) that can run Rust code.

resources.name: Symbolic PathFinder (SPF)
resources.desc: Symbolic execution tool built on Java PathFinder. Supports multiple constraint solvers, lazy initialization, etc.

resources.name: JDart
resources.desc: Dynamic symbolic execution tool built on Java PathFinder. Supports multiple constraint solvers using JConstraints.

resources.name: CATG
resources.desc: Concolic execution tool that uses ASM for instrumentation. Uses CVC4.

resources.name: LimeTB
resources.desc: Concolic execution tool that uses Soot for instrumentation. Supports Yices and Boolector. Concolic execution can be distributed.

resources.name: Acteve
resources.desc: Concolic execution tool that uses Soot for instrumentation. Originally for Android analysis. Supports Z3.

resources.name: jCUTE
resources.desc: Concolic execution tool that uses Soot for instrumentation. Supports lp_solve.

resources.name: JFuzz
resources.desc: Concolic execution tool built on Java PathFinder.

resources.name: JBSE
resources.desc: Symbolic execution tool that uses a custom JVM. Supports CVC3, CVC4, Sicstus, and Z3.

resources.name: Key
resources.desc: Theorem Prover that uses specifications written in Java Modeling Language (JML).

resources.name: SWAT
resources.desc: Loosely coupled dynamic symbolic execution using ASM for instrumentation, JavaSMT for formula generation and currently Z3 as a solver.

resources.name: KLEE
resources.desc: Symbolic execution engine built on LLVM.

resources.name: Cloud9
resources.desc: Parallel symbolic execution engine built on KLEE.

resources.name: Kite
resources.desc: Based on KLEE and LLVM.

resources.name: SymCC
resources.desc: A compiler wrapper which embeds symbolic execution into the program during compilation, and an associated run-time support library.

resources.name: GenSym
resources.desc: A compiler for parallel fork-based symbolic execution.

resources.name: PEX
resources.desc: Dynamic symbolic execution tool for .NET.

resources.name: VSharp
resources.desc: Symbolic execution engine for .NET assemblies.

resources.name: CREST
resources.desc: is an open-source tool for concolic testing of C programs.

resources.name: Otter
resources.desc: is a pure, source-level symbolic executor for C that can be used to test programs.

resources.name: CIVL
resources.desc: A framework that includes the CIVL-C programming language, a model checker and a symbolic execution tool.

resources.name: Jalangi2
resources.desc: Dynamic analysis framework for JavaScript.

resources.name: SymJS
resources.desc: Automatic symbolic testing of JavaScript web applications.

resources.name: CrossHair
resources.desc: Symbolic execution tool for verifying properties of Python functions.

resources.name: PyExZ3
resources.desc: Symbolic execution of Python functions. A rewrite of the NICE project's symbolic execution tool.

resources.name: APEX
resources.desc: Concolic execution engine for Python with coverage-guided test generation. Built in Rust.

resources.name: Rubyx
resources.desc: Symbolic execution tool for Ruby on Rails web apps.

resources.name: SymDroid
resources.desc: A Symbolic Executor to Identify Activity Permission in Android Application.

resources.name: SAGE
resources.desc: Whitebox file fuzzing tool for X86 Windows applications.

resources.name: DART
resources.desc: is the first concolic testing tool that combines dynamic test generation.

resources.name: BitBlaze
resources.desc: Binary Analysis for Computer Security.

resources.name: PathGrind
resources.desc: Path-based dynamic analysis for 32-bit programs.

resources.name: FuzzBALL
resources.desc: Symbolic execution tool built on the BitBlaze Vine component.

resources.name: S2E
resources.desc: Symbolic execution platform supporting x86, x86-64, or ARM software stacks.

resources.name: miasm
resources.desc: Reverse engineering framework. Includes symbolic execution.

resources.name: pysymemu
resources.desc: Supports x86/x64 binaries.

resources.name: BAP
resources.desc: Binary Analysis Platform provides a framework for writing program analysis tools.

resources.name: angr
resources.desc: Python framework for analyzing binaries. Includes a symbolic execution tool.

resources.name: Triton
resources.desc: Dynamic binary analysis platform that includes a dynamic symbolic execution tool.

resources.name: manticore
resources.desc: Symbolic execution tool for binaries (x86, x86_64 and ARMV7) and Ethereum smart contract bytecode.

resources.name: MAAT
resources.desc: Low-level symbolic execution tool, uses Ghidra's p-code.

resources.name: BinCAT
resources.desc: Binary code static analyser, with IDA integration. Performs value and taint analysis, type reconstruction, use-after-free and double-free detection.

resources.name: Sydr-Fuzz
resources.desc: Continuous Hybrid Fuzzing and Dynamic Analysis for Security Development Lifecycle.

resources.name: SymEx-VP
resources.desc: Symbolic execution for RISC-V embedded firmware with accurate SystemC peripheral models.

resources.name: Symbooglix
resources.desc: Symbolic execution tool for Boogie programs.

resources.name: OSS-Sydr-Fuzz
resources.desc: Hybrid Fuzzing for Open Source Software
